zh: 今天比昨天忙多了。
en: Today's way busier than yesterday.
alt: Today's much busier than yesterday.
point: …多了 → way / much + 比较级，不是 busier much

zh: 我的工作跟他的差不多。
en: My job's pretty similar to his.
alt: My job's much the same as his.
point: 差不多 → similar to，不是 almost same

zh: 这台笔记本没有我以前那台快。
en: This laptop isn't as fast as my old one.
alt: This laptop's slower than my old one.
point: 没有…快 → isn't as fast as

zh: 这是最新版吗？
en: Is this the latest version?
alt: Is this the most recent version?
point: 最新版 → the latest version，不说 the newest

zh: 这一带就数这家的炸鱼薯条最好吃。
en: This place has the best fish and chips around here.
alt: This place does the best fish and chips around.
point: 最好吃 → the best，不说 the most delicious

zh: 比起咖啡，我更喜欢喝茶。
en: I prefer tea to coffee.
alt: I'd rather have tea than coffee.
point: 更喜欢 A → prefer A to B，不是 prefer A than B

zh: 他跑得比我快。
en: He's faster than me.
alt: He runs faster than I do.
point: 比我快 → faster than me，不说 more fast

zh: 今年的球队比去年强一点。
en: This year's team is a bit stronger than last year's.
alt: The team's a bit better this year than last year.
point: 强一点 → a bit stronger；last year's 的 's 别漏

zh: 这个跟那个一样贵。
en: This one's just as expensive as that one.
alt: This one costs the same as that one.
point: 一样贵 → as expensive as，不是 same expensive

zh: 这双鞋比那双舒服。
en: These shoes are more comfortable than those.
alt: This pair's more comfortable than that pair.
point: 长形容词 → more comfortable，不说 comfortabler

zh: 坐火车比开车慢。
en: Taking the train is slower than driving.
alt: The train's slower than driving.
point: 比较双方要对称：taking the train 对 driving

zh: 惠灵顿的风比奥克兰大多了。
en: Wellington's a lot windier than Auckland.
alt: It's much windier in Wellington than in Auckland.
point: 风大 → windy，比较级 windier，不说 wind is bigger

zh: 我今天感觉好多了。
en: I'm feeling much better today.
alt: I feel a lot better today.
point: 好多了 → much better，不说 more better

zh: 他是我们办公室身体最好的。
en: He's the fittest person in our office.
alt: He's the fittest one in the office.
point: 身体最好 → the fittest，不是 the best body

zh: 新房子比原来的大一倍。
en: The new house is twice as big as the old one.
alt: Our new place is double the size of the old one.
point: 大一倍 → twice as big as，不是 one time bigger

zh: 楼上比楼下暖和。
en: It's warmer upstairs than downstairs.
alt: Upstairs is warmer than downstairs.
point: 句子要有主语 it；暖和 → warmer than

zh: 他跟他哥哥长得一模一样。
en: He looks exactly like his brother.
alt: He looks just the same as his brother.
point: 长得一样 → looks exactly like，不是 looks same

zh: 人越多越热闹！
en: The more, the merrier!
alt: The more people, the better!
point: 越多越好 → the more, the merrier，固定说法

zh: 这个月花得比上个月少。
en: I've spent less this month than last month.
alt: I've spent less this month than I did last month.
point: 花得少 → spent less than，钱不可数用 less

zh: 这张卡的利息最高。
en: This card has the highest interest rate.
alt: This card charges the most interest.
point: 最高 → the highest，最高级前加 the

zh: 新系统比旧的好用多了，就是得花点时间适应。
en: The new system's way easier to use than the old one, but it takes getting used to.
alt: The new system's much more user-friendly than the old one, though it takes a while to get used to.
point: 好用多了 → much easier to use than

zh: 这次的截止日期比我们想的要早。
en: The deadline for this one is earlier than we thought it'd be.
alt: This deadline's earlier than we expected.
point: 比想的早 → earlier than we thought

zh: 云服务器的费用是本地服务器的三倍。
en: The cloud servers cost three times as much as the ones on site.
alt: Cloud hosting is three times more expensive than our on-site servers.
point: 是…的三倍 → three times as much as

zh: 这两个方案差别不大，选哪个都行。
en: There's not much difference between the two options, so either's fine.
alt: The two options are pretty similar, so either one will do.
point: 差别不大 → not much difference between

zh: 这家的分量比我们上次去的那家大多了。
en: The portions here are way bigger than at the place we went to last time.
alt: You get much bigger portions here than at the place we tried last time.
point: 比较对象要对齐：portions here 对 at the place

zh: 这道菜没看上去那么辣，你可以尝尝。
en: It's not as spicy as it looks, so you should give it a try.
alt: It's not as hot as it looks. Give it a go.
point: 没看上去那么 → not as…as it looks

zh: 我现在游得没以前快了，可能是太久没练了。
en: I can't swim as fast as I used to. I'm probably out of practice.
alt: I'm not as quick in the pool as I used to be, probably because I'm out of practice.
point: 没以前快 → not as fast as I used to

zh: 对我来说，去现场看比在电视上看有意思多了。
en: For me, watching it live is way more fun than watching it on TV.
alt: I find going to the game much more fun than watching it on TV.
point: 有意思多了 → way more fun，fun 用 more

zh: 在网上买一般比在店里买便宜一点。
en: It's usually a bit cheaper to buy online than in store.
alt: Buying online is usually a little cheaper than buying in store.
point: 便宜一点 → a bit cheaper；online 对 in store

zh: 这两件看着一样，但这件的料子好很多。
en: These two look the same, but this one's made of much better fabric.
alt: They look identical, but the material on this one is far better.
point: 看着一样 → look the same；好很多 → much better

zh: 皇后镇的物价比奥克兰还贵，尤其是住宿。
en: Queenstown's even more expensive than Auckland, especially for accommodation.
alt: Things cost even more in Queenstown than in Auckland, especially places to stay.
point: 比…还贵 → even more expensive than，even 加强比较

zh: 这是我住过的最舒服的酒店。
en: This is the most comfortable hotel I've ever stayed in.
alt: This is the comfiest hotel I've ever stayed at.
point: 住过最…的 → the most…I've ever stayed in

zh: 我的血压比上次高了一点，所以我在少吃盐。
en: My blood pressure's slightly higher than last time, so I'm cutting back on salt.
alt: My blood pressure's gone up a bit since last time, so I'm eating less salt.
point: 高了一点 → slightly higher than last time

zh: 走路上班跟去健身房一样能锻炼身体。
en: Walking to work is just as good for you as going to the gym.
alt: Walking to work is as good a workout as going to the gym.
point: 一样能 → just as good for you as

zh: 我们现在的房租只有住市中心时候的一半。
en: Our rent's half what we paid when we lived in the CBD.
alt: We pay half the rent we did when we lived in the city centre.
point: 只有…一半 → half what we paid，不说 cheaper half

zh: 你房间越来越乱了，赶紧收拾一下。
en: Your room's getting messier and messier, so you need to tidy it up.
alt: Your room keeps getting messier. Can you give it a tidy?
point: 越来越 → 比较级 and 比较级

zh: 他比我想象的好相处多了。
en: He's much easier to get along with than I thought.
alt: He's a lot easier to get on with than I expected.
point: 比想象的 → than I thought；好相处 → easy to get along with

zh: 我们俩现在的爱好跟以前很不一样了。
en: Our interests are quite different from what they used to be.
alt: We're into really different things now compared to before.
point: 跟…不一样 → different from，不是 different with

zh: 在新西兰，租房和买房哪个更划算？
en: Is it better to rent or to buy in New Zealand?
alt: In New Zealand, which makes more sense, renting or buying?
point: 哪个更划算 → Is it better to A or B？

zh: 我的工资涨得没物价快。
en: My pay isn't going up as fast as the cost of living.
alt: My wages aren't keeping up with the cost of living.
point: 没有…快 → not as fast as；物价 → cost of living

zh: 跟上个季度比，我们的销售额涨了将近百分之二十，比预期好得多。
en: Compared to last quarter, our sales are up nearly twenty percent, which is far better than we'd forecast.
alt: Sales are up almost twenty percent on last quarter, which is well ahead of what we forecast.
point: 跟…比 → compared to；好得多 → far better than

zh: 这个方案虽然比另一个贵一点，但从长远看能省下更多时间和人力。
en: This option's a bit pricier than the other one, but in the long run it'll save us a lot more time and effort.
alt: This option costs slightly more than the other, but long term it'll save us much more time and work.
point: 贵一点 → a bit pricier；更多 → a lot more

zh: 我们测了一下，新架构的响应速度是原来的两倍，出错率也低了很多。
en: We ran some tests, and the new setup responds twice as fast as the old one, with a much lower error rate.
alt: Our tests show the new architecture is twice as fast as the old one and throws far fewer errors.
point: 两倍快 → twice as fast as；低很多 → much lower

zh: 与其每次都手动部署，不如花点时间把流程自动化，越早做越好。
en: Rather than deploying manually every time, we'd be better off automating the process, and the sooner, the better.
alt: Instead of deploying by hand every time, we should take the time to automate it, the sooner the better.
point: 与其…不如 → we'd be better off；越早越好 → the sooner, the better

zh: 说实话，那家新开的店没大家说的那么好，我还是更喜欢街角那家。
en: To be honest, the new place isn't as good as everyone says. I still prefer the one on the corner.
alt: Honestly, the new place doesn't live up to the hype. I still like the one on the corner better.
point: 没…说的那么好 → isn't as good as everyone says

zh: 这里的平白比我在国内喝过的任何一杯咖啡都顺滑。
en: The flat whites here are smoother than any coffee I've ever had back home.
alt: The flat whites here are smoother than anything I ever had back home.
point: 比任何…都 → 比较级 + than any

zh: 他今年的状态是我见过最好的，比他刚进队的时候稳多了。
en: He's in the best form I've ever seen him, and he's far more consistent than when he first joined the team.
alt: This is the best I've ever seen him play, and he's much more consistent than when he first joined.
point: 最好的状态 → the best form；稳多了 → far more consistent than when

zh: 跟橄榄球比起来，板球节奏慢得多，但现场气氛其实一点也不差。
en: Compared with rugby, cricket feels a lot slower, but the atmosphere at the ground is every bit as good.
alt: Cricket's much slower than rugby, but the atmosphere at the ground is just as good.
point: 一点也不差 → every bit as good；慢得多 → a lot slower

zh: 我比了几家店的价格，New World的牛奶比Countdown贵了将近一块钱。
en: I compared prices at a few shops, and milk at New World is nearly a dollar more than at Countdown.
alt: I checked a few supermarkets, and milk costs almost a dollar more at New World than at Countdown.
point: 贵一块钱 → a dollar more than，差额放在 more 前

zh: 这台吸尘器虽然最贵，但吸力最强，噪音也比别的小很多。
en: This vacuum's the most expensive one, but it's also the most powerful and much quieter than the others.
alt: This vacuum costs the most, but it's got the strongest suction and it's way quieter than the rest.
point: 最贵/最强 → the most…；小很多 → much quieter than

zh: 这次自驾比上次跟团玩得开心多了，想在哪儿停就在哪儿停。
en: We enjoyed this road trip far more than the tour we did last time, because we could stop wherever we liked.
alt: This road trip was heaps better than the tour last time, since we could stop wherever we wanted.
point: 玩得开心多了 → enjoyed…far more than

zh: 机票越早订越便宜，所以我们一般提前三个月就订好了。
en: The earlier you book flights, the cheaper they are, so we usually book about three months ahead.
alt: Flights get cheaper the earlier you book, so we normally book three months out.
point: 越…越… → the earlier…, the cheaper…

zh: 我现在比以前睡得早多了，白天精神也好了很多。
en: I'm going to bed much earlier than I used to, and I've got way more energy during the day.
alt: I go to bed a lot earlier than I used to, and I feel much more awake during the day.
point: 早多了 → much earlier than I used to；精神好 → more energy

zh: 这种新药比以前那种副作用少多了，而且一天只要吃一次。
en: This new medication has a lot fewer side effects than the old one, and you only have to take it once a day.
alt: The new medicine causes far fewer side effects than the old one, and it's just once a day.
point: 副作用少 → fewer side effects，可数名词用 fewer

zh: 我们把旧电暖器换成了热泵，屋里比以前暖和多了，电费也省了。
en: We replaced the old heaters with a heat pump, and the house is way warmer and cheaper to run than before.
alt: Since we swapped the old heaters for a heat pump, the house is much warmer and the power bill's lower.
point: 比以前暖和、省钱 → warmer and cheaper to run than before

zh: 跟公寓比，独立屋空间大得多，但要打理的事也多得多。
en: A standalone house gives you heaps more room than an apartment, but there's a lot more upkeep too.
alt: You get much more space in a standalone house than an apartment, but there's far more maintenance.
point: 多得多 → heaps more / a lot more；heaps 是新西兰口语

zh: 他的英语比我好太多了，可他说他刚来的时候跟我现在差不多。
en: His English is miles better than mine, but he says when he first arrived it was about the same as mine is now.
alt: His English is way better than mine, but he reckons it was about where mine is now when he first got here.
point: 好太多 → miles better than；差不多 → about the same as

zh: 比起一大帮人聚会，我更喜欢跟几个好朋友安安静静吃顿饭。
en: I'd much rather have a quiet dinner with a few close mates than go to a big party.
alt: I prefer a quiet meal with a few good friends to a big party.
point: 宁愿 A 不愿 B → I'd rather A than B，A、B 都用原形

zh: 现在定期存款的利率还不如通胀高，钱放着其实是在贬值。
en: Term deposit rates are lower than inflation right now, so your savings are actually losing value.
alt: Right now term deposits pay less than inflation, so your money's actually shrinking in real terms.
point: 还不如…高 → lower than，中文否定比较转成肯定比较级

zh: 跟去年这个时候比，我们家每周买菜多花了大概五十块。
en: We're spending about fifty dollars more a week on groceries than we were this time last year.
alt: Compared with this time last year, our weekly grocery bill is up by about fifty dollars.
point: 多花五十块 → fifty dollars more…than；比较对象 this time last year
